checks: Natural code-zero completion is required for every preceding owned stage, with no stop reason, failure phase, first failure, monitor failure, active group, unreaped leader or unverified cleanup. Required configure/configuration/export/Rust/archive stages each occur once.

Available untruncated sampled birth history is required. A fresh self-bound full kernel snapshot checks known births independently of current UID/RUID and process group; live and unreaped zombie matches both reject. Invalid known identities and unavailable snapshots remain failures.

The prior global new-UID zero wait and ambient task-counter accounting are explicitly replaced. Unmeasured ambient usage is NOT_MEASURED_OUTSIDE_DECLARED_OWNED_SCOPE, never a zero-resource or nonwriter assertion. Active owned-group sampling, resource limits and unknown-sample stopping remain unchanged.

Producer and consumer require the versioned completion contract. Successful libgkrust archive and dependency-info hashes are tied to captured object manifest rows. Exact descriptor-stream hashing, pre/post metadata, archive readback, complete selected-root rescan and restore/content/configuration checks remain required.

Pinned harness recording patch applies after the existing startup patch with base/result/helper hashes checked. Independent execution reproduced patch application, reversed only the recording patch to prove the entire HostProcess class AST unchanged, reapplied it, and verified prepared final files.

Daily and fixed QA context/GUI paths preserve separate first functional failure, first reported disconnect cause, pre-cleanup and post-cleanup host/launcher/child observations, and independent cleanup outcomes. Existing context counts, first-failure evidence, streams and lifecycle records remain present.

New public diagnostics reproject fixed enums, booleans and bounded numeric facts; process identities, argv, paths, app IDs, nonces and arbitrary exception text are discarded. Durable exclusive mode-0600/fsync pre-cleanup records precede cleanup requests. A reported reason is not established root cause.

Recording unittest failures use an explicit fixed-source opt-in, retain exact static test identities and exception types, and expose only verified canonical source basenames and in-range lines. Unknown identities and private aliases do not become public facts.
